title: xDrip+ can work on a Xiaomi with MIUI 10.3.10 (Android 9)?
symptom: The user is considering changing to a Xiaomi Redmi Note 7 with MIUI 10.3.10 (Android 9) and is concerned that xDrip+ may not work on this device due to known problems with Android 9. They ask if anyone has experience using xDrip+ with this OS.
evidence_quote: I would like to know if someone uses phones with this IO, and if he had problems.
